strongest_counterevidence: A caller that can choose both trusted-key path and expected key hash can choose a self-consistent root; this proves key consistency, not independent release authority.
Local monotonic state can be rolled back by host or snapshot restoration unless anchored in a stronger non-rollbackable or externally reconciled authority.

A release candidate tested before PR 648 cannot be promoted over current main without recomposition and exact-head retest because ClayEnv CLI/workflow overlap can weaken the unresolved-use fail-closed boundary.

Advancing release state before actual ClayOS execution success can ratchet the local fence on a non-runnable release; state advancement should remain after successful execution while artifact/provenance preflight still happens before execution.
